title: War and Peace
author: Leo Tolstoy
firstLine: “Well, Prince, so Genoa and Lucca are now just family estates of the Buonapartes.
begins: Book One, Chapter I: in July 1805 Anna Pávlovna Schérer, maid of honor to the Empress, holds an evening reception in St. Petersburg. Prince Vasíli Kurágin arrives first and they talk of Napoleon, war, and a match for his son Anatole.
happens: Russian families, the Rostóvs, Bolkónskis and Bezúkhovs, live through the Napoleonic wars. Pierre Bezúkhov inherits a fortune, marries the faithless Hélène and fights a duel with Dólokhov. Prince Andrew is wounded at Austerlitz; after his wife dies he is engaged to Natásha Rostóva, but she is drawn to Anatole Kurágin and her note to Princess Mary breaks off the engagement. When Napoleon invades in 1812, Pierre is at Borodinó, then captured by the French. Andrew is mortally wounded at Borodinó and dies with Natásha and Princess Mary beside him. Moscow burns, the French retreat, and Pétya Rostóv is killed. In the epilogue Pierre marries Natásha and Nicholas Rostóv marries Princess Mary.
